description: This file defines an interface 'SubscriptionEventAdapterProvider' that provides a method to obtain an event adapter for subscription events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It acts as a provider interface for dependency injection or factory purposes, specifically for classes that handle event subscriptions.

classes.name: SubscriptionEventAdapterProvider
classes.description: Interface providing the event adapter for subscription events, parameterized by a generic Event type extending Event<?>.

methods.name: getSubscriptionEventAdapter
methods.description: Returns the Adapter instance for the specific event type, facilitating event handling for subscription events.
